display_title: The End of the Villainess Is Not an Option
description:
Evelia, trapped in a cliché romance novel as the villainess, is forced to confront her predetermined death. As she attempts to change the narrative and avoid her tragic fate, the original storyline seems to actively work against her, trying to erase her existence. 

Desperate for survival, Evelia forms an unlikely alliance with Reaf, the assassin sent to kill her, and together they fight to survive.
